problem.passage:
The octopus's ability to change both color and texture in fractions of a second has long fascinated biologists, but the mechanism behind this feat remained partly mysterious until recent imaging studies. Researchers knew that specialized skin cells called chromatophores allowed rapid color shifts, yet the coordination required to also alter skin texture—raising bumps to mimic coral or flattening to resemble sand—seemed to demand a level of neural control that appeared inconsistent with the octopus's relatively decentralized nervous system, in which roughly two-thirds of neurons reside not in the brain but in the arms themselves. New high-speed footage combined with neural mapping has shown that local reflexes in the skin and arms, rather than centralized commands from the brain, drive much of this fine-tuned camouflage, resolving the apparent contradiction between limited centralized processing and remarkably sophisticated bodily transformation.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

problem.question: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
options: To describe how new research explained a puzzle about how octopuses achieve complex camouflage despite decentralized neural control
To argue that octopus camouflage is less sophisticated than previously believed by earlier biologists
To compare the nervous systems of octopuses and other camouflaging animals in detail
To recommend a new imaging method for studying marine invertebrate behavior
problem.explanation: 지문은 문어의 위장 능력과 분산된 신경계 사이의 모순처럼 보이던 문제를 새로운 연구가 어떻게 해결했는지 설명하는 데 초점을 맞춘다. 처음에 문제(신경계 구조와 정교한 위장 능력 사이의 불일치)를 제시하고, 마지막 문장에서 새로운 발견(국소 반사가 위장을 주도한다)이 이를 해결한다고 서술한다. 따라서 정답은 A번이다. B는 지문이 위장 능력을 폄하하지 않으므로 틀리다. C는 다른 동물과의 비교가 지문에 없으므로 틀리다. D는 촬영 기법 자체를 권장하는 내용이 아니라 그 기법이 밝혀낸 결과에 초점이 있으므로 틀리다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage focuses on explaining how new research resolved what seemed like a contradiction between the octopus's decentralized nervous system and its sophisticated camouflage abilities. It opens with the puzzle (structural mismatch between neural architecture and camouflage complexity) and closes by showing how new findings (local reflexes driving camouflage) resolve it. So the correct answer is A. B is wrong because the passage does not diminish the sophistication of octopus camouflage. C is wrong because no comparison to other animals appears in the text. D is wrong because the passage is not recommending an imaging method but reporting what it revealed.
problem.evidenceSpan: New high-speed footage combined with neural mapping has shown that local reflexes in the skin and arms, rather than centralized commands from the brain, drive much of this fine-tuned camouflage, resolving the apparent contradiction between limited centralized processing and remarkably sophisticated bodily transformation.
problem.answerRationale: 이 문단은 처음부터 끝까지 '왜 이 현상이 설명되었는가'라는 하나의 중심 주장을 전개하며, 마지막 문장이 그 해결책을 제시하는 핵심 주장 역할을 한다.

difficultyReasons: 지문 전체를 읽고 핵심 주제(모순 해결)를 파악해야 하므로 최소 2단계 추론 필요
오답 D가 이미징 언급을 활용한 세부사항 오답이라 정답과 일부 정보 공유도가 있어 신중한 독해 요구
오답 B, C는 명백히 지문과 무관하거나 반대되어 상대적으로 쉽게 제거 가능
